Optimize AI performance and cost

Stop guessing. Optimize model performance and cost in real time.

Compare models, measure real-world performance and cost, and route traffic to the best option—automatically, in production. All without redeploying.

Book a demo

Agents run in production. Optimization should, too.

Without Runtime Control
  • Prompt and model tuning is difficult, manual, and requires a redeploy.
  • Visibility into what’s working is limited, and you are always behind.
  • Performance and costs spike with no way to set guardrails on models.
  • Hardcoded configs guarantee you are overpaying or underperforming.
With Runtime Control
  • Teams define the goal, constraints, and metrics that matter for AI performance.
  • The system automatically creates variants, runs evals, and surfaces what performs best. caught at the first sign of degradation.
  • Configs are adjusted in real time, in production—with full visibility and control.
  • AI performance and cost is continuously optimized.

Quickstart Guide

AgentControl

  • 01Define configs and run offline evals.

    Set up prompt, model, or parameter variations. Test them against benchmark datasets before any production traffic sees them.

  • 02Experiment in production.

    Expose variations to real users and measure cost, latency, and output quality against your defined targets. Find what actually wins under real conditions.

  • 03Promote the winner and optimize continuously.

    Route traffic to the best-performing config and keep iterating. No redeploy required.

What this unlocks in production.

01

Reduce AI spend while improving performance and quality.

02

Automatically optimize for best variants as production changes.

03

Scale AI usage with full visibility and control. No manual tuning or guesswork.

04

Turn model selection into a continuous optimization loop.

We can take bigger risks in the kinds of AI features we build, and we can validate that they’re worth it because we can see downstream impacts all the way through.

Jon Noronha

Ship AI-built code with confidence

AI coded it, but you own it in production.
Stay in control.

AI ships code faster than teams can validate it. Release confidently, detect issues instantly, and automatically fix problems in production—no redeploys, no fire drills.

Book a demo

At AI speed, control in production is essential.

Without Runtime Control
  • Ship and hope: no control once changes hit production.
  • Issues are discovered only after users are impacted.
  • Rollbacks are slow, manual, and disruptive.
  • Every incident depends on someone jumping in to fix it.
With Runtime Control
  • Ship with control: pre-defined guardrails, success metrics, and automated rollouts.
  • Change-level issues are detected immediately—before users are impacted.
  • Remediation is instant, automated, and non-disruptive.
  • Incidents are handled—no one needs to jump in.

Quickstart Guide

CodeControl

  • 01Define the change and guardrails.

    Create a feature and tie it to key system and business metrics. Define thresholds for performance, errors, or user impact before release.

  • 02Release and observe in production.

About LaunchDarkly

Making software releases boring since 2014.

LaunchDarkly was founded in 2014 in Oakland, California, by Edith Harbaugh and John Kodumal, to solve a clear problem in modern software delivery: Teams were releasing code faster in the cloud, but they still lacked safe, practical control over what happened after deployment.

We set out to make feature management accessible beyond the small group of companies that had built homegrown systems. Over time, we expanded from helping developers soft-launch features to giving product, marketing, and business teams more control over rollouts and customer experiences as well.

Today, LaunchDarkly is the runtime control layer for the AI era of software development, reflecting how we’ve evolved from pioneering feature management into a broader platform for controlling software releases, experimentation, observability, and AI agent behavior in production. We now serve more than 5,500 customers, including roughly a quarter of the Fortune 500.

Our vision is to create a world in which every AI-powered release is safe and unceremonious.

#1 in Feature Management for 3 years running.

Trusted by product teams. Proven in production.
